notes.content: Dear players, in accordance with the tradition left behind, for every game purchased by a player, we will contribute our humble efforts to public welfare. notes.title: Notice of the Domestic Game Challenge Reward Activity
notes.content:
Dear players, the welfare storm is coming with great force! A mysterious big shot, with a passionate heart for domestic games, has launched this grand challenge event. There are numerous exciting gifts waiting for you to win! ​
Activity Rules
Game Achievement Challenge: Choose any one of the four ingenious domestic games, "Ancient Elegance", "Princess Gou Ba Rhapsodom", "Princess Dongfang and Expedition", and "Double Heroes' Legacy", to unlock all your achievements and write your game legend with your strength! ​
2. Game duration test: Accumulate 3 hours or more of playtime in the selected games, deeply immerse yourself in the elaborately crafted game world, and feel the charm of every detail. ​
3. Share game insights: After completing your achievements, go to the Steam game page and leave your genuine comments. Whether it's praise or suggestions, they can all inject new vitality into the game. ​

This reward is not only an acknowledgement of everyone's gaming skills, but also aims to promote the subsequent improvement and optimization of the game. Looking back over the past two years, from hand-drawing to the iterative upgrade of AI technology, every step of growth has been inseparable from the support of players. We are not a big company. We have made it this far all thanks to the company and encouragement of all our players. Every reward is our gratitude and repayment to all of you. Every reward carries our expectations for the future of the game. We hope that through everyone's participation and feedback, it will help us refine the game even more perfectly and achieve a transformation from zero to one and from something to something excellent. ​

Reward collection method
When you successfully complete the above three challenges, contact the administrator immediately, show the game achievement mark, duration record and screenshot of the Steam review, and you can participate in the event! ​
Don't hesitate any longer. Start this domestic game challenge journey right away. Fight for your passion and contribute to the development of domestic games. Who knows, the lucky prize might just win at your home!

notes.title: 新游《双雄风流传》现已上线
notes.content:
A new game developed according to everyone's opinions and requirements
For the first time in the game, there are two protagonists, as the king of a country, you will be placed in a splendid palace, facing the internal strife above the court.

Solve puzzles and unravel conspiracies: Through the form of a visual novel, you will step by step uncover the secrets hidden in the depths of the court. Assassinations, betrayals, conspiracy... You need to strategize, see through the enemy's tricks, and protect your imperial power!

Emotional interweaving, confidant: In the vortex of power, you will meet with a number of different characters of the heroine. They may be gentle and virtuous, or wise and courageous, or mysterious. There may be crucial links in their speeches, and grasp the clues in them to overthrow the power of treacherous ministers at one stroke.


And as a vassal, you will be far from the prosperity of the imperial city, into the fireworks of the city.

Build, develop power: Through city management and construction, you will manage people, plant labor, develop technology, and gradually grow your power. From desolation to prosperity, your every step is crucial!

Build an army and conquer the imperial city: Eventually, you will lead a large army to conquer the imperial city and overthrow the dynasty. In the process, you will fight against different organizations and cultivate the best until you become the master of the entire kingdom!

The game's CG quality and optimization are significantly better than the previous game, come and try it

notes.title: Try to solve the problem of the game opening black screen and the character runn
notes.content:
Recently, many black screen games have been opened for players to open black screen and character automatic running problems.

After multiple rounds of testing and code inspection by the project team, no code errors that may cause the above problems have been found.

The initial guess is the system and memory usage problem, please follow the following steps to try again:
1. Close the WIN system's built-in kill software and other kill software (because our program package has added binary encryption software in the design, it may be mistakenly killed, resulting in the loss of some files)
2. Check whether the memory in the running state of the game is full. Memory explosion may also cause the above problems
3. Some player homemade CE can also lead to the above problems

After checking the above issues, uninstall and reinstall the game to see if the above issues are resolved.
If there are still problems, please give us feedback here and attach your archive file, thank you for your support!!

notes.title: Princess: East and the Expedition will be updated in part
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for your support and comments on Princess: East and Expedition games. During this period, we will continue to optimize according to player feedback and game problems, and strive to do the best. We'll keep trying. Please give us some time.
Second, we will disclose some of the next version of the update:
1. There will be an increase in the circadian system and related events
2. Strengthen casual play such as planting, fishing, planting flowers, and cute pets, and give everyone a variety of props to obtain choices
3. The main mission of Yanshen has opened two new imperial cities and related missions
4. Add more CG to enrich CG quality
5. More female characters will be introduced along with stories
6. Add indoor scenes to enrich exploration

During this period, we will continue to optimize the BUG problem and give you a better game experience, thank you!!
